name: Sarah Dieudonne
source:
"I shall surrender my body to you. Please keep the people of this city safe."

A girl who grew up in a city near the Berezinsky domain. She lost her mother when she was very young, so she was raised by the local convent. With a pure heart and a strong devotion to God, she has always aspired to work for the church, hoping to help children in similar circumstances to her own. However, caught up in the schemes of the city's powerful figures, she was taken to the Berezinsky domain as a sacrificial offering.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/WitchB_otomate/status/2011000276816134563]Twitter[/url]]
